def line_cells(a,b):
    (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=a,b
    dr,dc=r2-r1,c2-c1
    n=max(abs(dr),abs(dc))
    out=[]
    for i in range(1,n):  # exclude endpoints
        t=i/n
        r=round(r1+dr*t); c=round(c1+dc*t)
        out.append((r,c))
    return out
